Ancestral Communion.descriptionOnly: +4, +6 at caster level 7th and +8 at 11th, on a Knowledge check after a full-round action consulting the spirits

Ancestral Gift.descriptionOnly: no path: the conjured weapon's +1 enhancement bonus and special ability are its own

Bloodsworn Retribution.descriptionOnly: no path: a morale bonus of the damage taken (25 at most) divided by 5 on rolls toward the oath, judged at the table; the example's 20 hit points give +4

Oath of Justice.descriptionOnly: no path: the oath-breaker's –4 to influence dwarves comes only with the mark of a broken oath

Peacemaker's Parley.descriptionOnly: no path: +2 sacred on its one Diplomacy check against creatures that failed their saves

Planned Assault.descriptionOnly: +2, +4 at 10th level and +6 at 15th, only while the declared actions are taken

Tactical Formation.descriptionOnly: only while adjacent to another creature it affects
